scope: Repository-local agent efficiency capabilities manifest. All capabilities are optional aids; none establish project authority or modify Rewrotron specifications.

pxpipe.name: pxpipe
pxpipe.purpose: Renders bulky Tier-1 context (system prompts, tool definitions, older history) to compact PNG pages for supported vision models, reducing request tokens.
pxpipe.configuration_state: Service loopback endpoint http://127.0.0.1:47821 or intercepting proxy active; local CA bundle present at ~/.pxpipe/warp-ca-bundle.pem
pxpipe.installation_mechanism: npm install -g pxpipe-proxy (or project-local npm install pxpipe-proxy)
pxpipe.security_approval_requirement: Local loopback proxy with dynamic self-signed CA bundle for TLS termination; requires explicit user approval before automated installation.

rtk.name: rtk
rtk.purpose: Suppresses redundant command boilerplate and compacts CLI output (locate → narrow → inspect) to minimize token consumption while preserving exit codes and error diagnostics.
rtk.configuration_state: Binary in PATH or wrapper alias configured in agent shell
rtk.installation_mechanism: Package manager or direct binary release; see documentation
rtk.security_approval_requirement: Binary execution wrapper; requires explicit user review and approval before automated installation.

code_graph.name: code-review-graph
code_graph.purpose: Analyzes code impact, symbol caller/callee graphs, and dependency relationships to narrow file and test reading surface prior to edits. Index only; never source of truth.
code_graph.configuration_state: Local repository graph index or CLI binary in PATH
code_graph.installation_mechanism: Project-local npm/python package or system binary
code_graph.security_approval_requirement: Static analysis indexing tool; read-only repository access; requires explicit user approval before automated installation.

session_handoff.name: session_handoff
session_handoff.purpose: Standardizes compact pointer-based handoffs (unit, files, tests, blockers, checkpoint commit, next unit) across sessions using native Git history and repository artifacts without external databases.
session_handoff.configuration_state: Clean git working tree or staged checkpoint in repository
session_handoff.security_approval_requirement: Built-in repository version control; no third-party installation needed.
